name: China Shipbuilding Industry Corporation
zh: 中国船舶重工集团有限公司
zhAliases: 中国船舶重工集团公司

evidence.summary: CSIC was one of China’s two state-owned shipbuilding groups until late 2019, when, with the approval of the Party Central Committee and the State Council, it merged with the former China State Shipbuilding Corporation into China State Shipbuilding Corporation Limited, which SASTIND lists among China’s defence-industry group companies and which builds all of the PLA Navy’s main combat equipment.
